description: This file contains Alembic migration scripts for adding alert-related tables ('alerts', 'alert_logs', 'alert_owner') to the database schema in the Superset project.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Creates new tables for alerts, alert logs, and alert owners, and an index on the 'alerts' table.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Drops the index and tables created in the upgrade function.
